title: elmp_quiz (D-87, D-91)
description: mode check = not graded, instant feedback per question, unlimited retries, completes on first submit. mode exam = graded (only this counts, D-91), attempts, best score, completes when graded. The server keeps 'answer' and 'explain'; the browser gets questions without them (grading.public_questions). Exam review after submit shows right/wrong + explain per question, never the correct choice.

max_attempts.description: exam only; 0 = unlimited. Enforced on the server.

pass_pct.description: exam only; shown to the learner and used for 'passed'. The course grade cut-off itself stays in Open edX grading policy.

shuffle.description: Shuffle question order and choices per attempt (server side).

weight.description: exam only; points in the course grade. Empty = number of questions.

answer.description: Choice ids. single = exactly one. Never sent to the browser.
